page.overview:
Who is Duri?

Duri was a member of the rebellion who acquired and sold thinking machines.

Duri met with Horace and sold him a drone that could navigate into the throne room and then explode, killing everyone in the room. Before they could implement this plan, however, Imperial guards, working on intel from Desmond Hart, who had gotten it from Natalya Arat Corrino, arrested Horace and Duri and brought them to the palace, where Desmond publicly executed them.
